def.brief: Fix the inconsistencies the adopt-prior review demonstrated between the adopted Python 3.11+/python3 floor (README Install: python3 on PATH must meet 3.11) and the rest of the shipped text: (1) README Install says 'the engine, command adapters and hooks use that executable' — mangsang ships no hooks (no hooks/ directory, no hooks key in any manifest): drop 'and hooks'. (2) skills/operate/SKILL.md says '(`python` on hosts that have no `python3`)' — contradicts the floor: say python3 3.11+ is required instead. (3) README Self-check runs `python test_mangsang.py` / `python test_properties.py` while AGENTS.md says python3: use python3. (4) commands/judge.md tells the agent to run `python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/judge_worker.py"` while the engine's own next line (mangsang.py judge request) prints python3: use python3. Nothing else changes; test docstrings are left alone.
